scope: Implement the two immediate discovery resource-exhaustion fixes and both smaller retention/network follow-ups, integrated with ongoing high-priority hardening. Local only.

requirements.change: Discovery-only NOWAIT account privacy fences at authentication and every commit. Contended requests return503/Retry-After1 without joining owner-row lock queues; revocation/removal remain authoritative. Shared small/bulk query slots are capped at max(1,min(3,pool_size-1)); this reserves other gameplay capacity when pool_size>1.

Separate durable ordinary/expensive work credits, independent of view creation. Random, text/non-text filters, personal state and authenticated initializations use the expensive lane. One ten-second expensive lease per actor across replicas; fenced tokens cannot commit/refund/release replacement work. Actual query/Random/visibility budget failures trigger shared2/4/8/16/30s cooldown, preserving cheap browsing. Older replica windows cannot reset newer credit windows. Request connections are released before refund metadata transactions.

requirements.change: Bounded captured-epoch indexed batches discard nonexistent favorite/history IDs; unused history is not copied. Device-local lists remain untouched. Outstanding actor and sixteen service-stripe member/charged-byte caps include expired physical rows. Counters, insertion, expiry and erasure commit/rollback atomically. Legacy members remain intact during512-member indexed backfill; accounting compares cursor tuples with database collation, including Unicode. New member writes wait503 until ready.

requirements.change: Secondary shared anonymous IPv6/64 or IPv4/32 read/burst/create/member budgets. Small anonymous reception is additionally capped at two/network and four/process. Trusted proxy resolution and exact peer cursor identity are retained. Validated signed-in players keep separate account budgets and receiver capacity.
